notes: §1985:IX.4.5.2 prints Format 1 'READ file-name-1 [NEXT] RECORD [INTO identifier-1] [AT END ...] [NOT AT END ...] [END-READ]' and Format 2 with [KEY IS data-name-1] [INVALID KEY ...] [NOT INVALID KEY ...], each written 'in the sequence given in the general formats' (§1985:IV.2.1). readStatement keeps NEXT, RECORD, INTO and KEY in printed order (KEY IS before INTO is COBOL2269), ConditionalPhraseAssociation keeps the two formats' phrases apart (AT END beside KEY IS or INVALID KEY beside NEXT: COBOL2269; a phrase written twice: COBOL2269), BindRead with CheckReadRandomAccessPhrases and CheckReadKeyFormat refuses AT END on a random file and KEY IS or INVALID KEY on a sequential-access file (COBOL1720, COBOL0864), and the defect the prior PARTIAL named is now closed: VersionConformancePass.VisitConditionalPhrases asks ConditionalPhraseAssociation.OutOfPrintedOrder and refuses NOT AT END before AT END and NOT INVALID KEY before INVALID KEY at 85 (COBOL0900, construct conditional-phrases-any-order-2002). Probed at --std 85 on an indexed DYNAMIC file: (b) both reversed pairs, a repeated AT END, KEY IS with AT END, NEXT with INVALID KEY, INTO after KEY IS, all refused; (c) PREVIOUS, WITH LOCK and IGNORING LOCK refused COBOL0900; (e) random READ INTO with INVALID KEY / NOT INVALID KEY printed 001ALPHA, then READ NEXT at end ran AT END ('AE'), and RANDOM and SEQUENTIAL access arms refused as above. Classes a, d, f do not reach a format rule. The witness runs both formats in printed order, with and without NEXT, KEY IS and RECORD. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5102 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5158 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-05.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-05-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 indexed READ: Format 1 READ file-name-1 [NEXT] RECORD [INTO] [AT END] [NOT AT END] [END-READ]; Format 2 READ … [KEY IS data-name-1] [INVALID KEY] [NOT INVALID KEY] [END-READ]. §2023:14.9.30.2 adds PREVIOUS, ADVANCING ON LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, WITH [NO] LOCK, retry-phrase and record-key-name-1, and its choice indicators let AT END/NOT AT END and INVALID KEY/NOT INVALID KEY appear in either order; §2023:14.9.30.3 SR8 and SR9 state when the omitted NEXT is implied ("the NEXT phrase is implied"). Every 1985 READ keeps its meaning; cases are added at compile time.
